title: How Gen Z Ended Up in So Much Debt
summary: Documentary-style video on Gen Z debt includes buy now pay later among the factors driving younger generations deeper into debt.

assertions.quote: the rise of buy now, pay later products has driven Gen Z into more debt
Young people are facing a serious debt problem
It's so easy to lose track of how much you're spending

verdicts.note: Doom-spending research documents the fatalistic mindset and its link to higher spending, but doesn't isolate BNPL specifically as the mechanism rather than digital payments generally.

assertions.quote: The gap between wages and cost of living has pushed many younger people to increasingly turn to credit cards to pay for goods and services

verdicts.note: Consistent with reported wage-to-cost-of-living gaps and rising average debt balances among younger generations.
LendingTree: Gen Z (61%) and millennials (57%) are far more likely to at least consider a BNPL loan this month than Gen X (33%) or baby boomers (20%).
